description: This file contains the implementation of the 'Loader' class within the Opencart System Engine namespace. The class provides methods to load models, libraries, configurations, helpers, and handle controller and view rendering, acting as a core component for dynamic resource management and execution flow in the OpenCart framework.

classes.name: Loader
classes.description: Core class responsible for dynamically loading models, libraries, configurations, helpers, controllers, and views, as well as providing property overloading for resource access.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Loader with a Registry instance for resource management.

methods.name: __get
methods.description: Property overloading method to access registry entries dynamically.

methods.name: controller
methods.description: Handles the invocation of controllers by route, triggering pre- and post-execution events.

methods.name: model
methods.description: Loads and retrieves a model object specified by route, converting route paths into class names, creating or fetching from registry, and invoking the model's callable method.

methods.name: library
methods.description: Loads and retrieves a library object specified by route, creating or fetching it from registry.

methods.name: config
methods.description: Loads and returns configuration data for a given route, triggering relevant events.

methods.name: helper
methods.description: Includes helper PHP files based on route, with special handling for extension helpers.

methods.name: view
methods.description: Renders a view template with provided data, managing pre- and post-render events.

methods.name: language
methods.description: Loads language resources for a given route, with optional prefix and code, including event triggers.
